title: RLC 串联谐振：扫频找 f0
summary: 10 mH + 100 nF + 100 Ω 串联。扫频找电流最大、和电压同相的谐振频率 f0，看谐振时电容上的电压比电源还高，再看 f0 两边电路呈容性还是感性。
concepts: 容性 / 感性 capacitive / inductive
description: 信号发生器 → L1（10 mH）→ C1（100 nF）→ VR → R1（100 Ω）→ GND。电阻放在接地一端，CH2 在 VR 上看到的就是电流的波形。

cards.title: 转旋钮，找最大的那一刻
text: 信号发生器：**正弦波、幅度 `1 V`**，频率从 **`2.5 kHz`** 慢慢调到 **`10 kHz`**。
CH2 先变大、再变小。它最大的时候，CH1 和 CH2 两条波形的波峰对得齐吗？

cards.title: 两个方向相反的“阻力”正好抵消
text: - 电感的感抗 $X_L = 2\pi f L$ 随频率**变大**；电容的容抗 $X_C = \frac{1}{2\pi f C}$ 随频率**变小**。
- 它们的作用方向相反：电感让电流落后，电容让电流超前。两者相等的那个频率，它们正好**抵消**，只剩电阻挡着电流——电流最大，而且和电压同相。这叫**谐振**。
![](fig:reactances)
- 令 $X_L = X_C$，就得到谐振频率：
动手之前先算出来。低于 $f_0$ 电容占上风，高于 $f_0$ 电感占上风。
![](fig:peak)

cards.title: 找 f0，再看电容上的电压
text: - **扫频**：找 CH2 和 CH1 相位差正好过 0 的频率，那里 CH2 也最大。
- 频率调到 **`2.5 kHz`**：读 CH2 相对 CH1 的相位差；再调到 **`10 kHz`** 看一眼相位的正负。
- 回到 $f_0$，把 **CH2 夹到电容两端**：针尖插 **`d9`**，接地夹插 **`a14`**（探头量的是“针尖减接地夹”）。和 CH1 比一比，电容上的电压比加上去的电压大还是小？

cards.title: 带走
text: - **串联谐振**：$X_L = X_C$，阻抗最小（只剩电阻），电流最大，电流和电压同相。
- 低于 $f_0$ 电路呈**容性**（电流超前），高于 $f_0$ 呈**感性**（电流落后）。
- 谐振时 L 和 C 上的电压大小相等、方向相反，各自可以是电源电压的好几倍（品质因数 Q 倍）。
- 坑：Q 很高的串联谐振电路里，电容上的电压能比电源高几十倍。真实电路要看电容的**耐压**。

caption.text: X_L 随频率上升，X_C 随频率下降；两条线相交的地方就是谐振频率 f_0。

i18n.en: X_L rises with frequency and X_C falls; where the two lines cross is the resonant frequency f_0.

caption.text: 电流（CH2 的大小）随频率变化：在 f_0 处达到最高，两边都下降。

i18n.en: The current (the size of CH2) against frequency: highest at f_0, falling on both sides.

en.title: Series RLC resonance: sweep for f0
en.summary: 10 mH + 100 nF + 100 Ω in series. Sweep for the resonant frequency f0, where the current is largest and in phase with the voltage; see the capacitor voltage beat the source there, and find which side of f0 is capacitive and which inductive.
en.description: Generator → L1 (10 mH) → C1 (100 nF) → VR → R1 (100 Ω) → GND. The resistor sits at the grounded end, so CH2 on VR shows the current.
compare: - When ωL = 1/(ωC) the reactances cancel, |Z| is at its minimum R + r, the current is at its maximum, and current and voltage are **in phase**: f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) = 1/(2π√(10 mH × 100 nF)) ≈ 5033 Hz.

- At f0: v_R/v_in = 100/101 ≈ 0.99, phase ≈ 0°. RMS current = (1 V/√2)/(101 + 50) Ω ≈ 4.7 mA (the generator's 50 Ω counts here: at resonance the circuit's impedance is small and 50 Ω takes a third of the voltage — that's why only about 1.34 Vpp is left at the VIN terminals).

- **Voltage magnification**: at resonance X_L = X_C = √(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω. V_C = V_L = I·316 Ω, which is Q = 316/101 ≈ 3.1 times the terminal voltage VIN: about 4.2 Vpp across the capacitor while VIN is only 1.34 Vpp! V_L and V_C are equal and opposite and cancel, so KVL still holds. (Strictly, the capacitor voltage peaks slightly below f0 — about 4.24 Vpp at 4.5 kHz — but the difference is small.)
- f < f0 (e.g. 2.5 kHz): 1/(ωC) > ωL, the circuit is **capacitive** and the current **leads** the voltage: v_R/v_in ≈ 0.20, phase ≈ +78°.
- f > f0 (e.g. 10 kHz): ωL > 1/(ωC), the circuit is **inductive** and the current **lags**: v_R/v_in ≈ 0.21, phase ≈ −78°.
- The half-power points (v_R/v_in = 0.707 × 0.99) are near 4.3 kHz and 5.9 kHz; bandwidth BW = (R + r)/(2πL) ≈ 1.6 kHz, and f0/BW ≈ 3.1 = Q.

measurements.ask: Sweep: the frequency f0 where VR is in phase with VIN (0° phase difference) and largest
measurements.explain: The reactances cancel when ωL = 1/(ωC): f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) ≈ 5.03 kHz.

measurements.ask: f = 2.5 kHz: the phase of VR (i.e. the current) relative to VIN
measurements.explain: Below f0, 1/(ωC) > ωL: the circuit is capacitive and the current leads, so the phase is positive.

measurements.ask: f = 5033 Hz: CH2 across the capacitor (tip d9, clip a14), the capacitor voltage's Vpp
measurements.explain: At resonance X_C = X_L = √(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω and the current is ≈ 4.7 mA (rms), so the capacitor voltage is Q = 316/101 ≈ 3.1 times VIN: about 4.2 Vpp while VIN is only about 1.34 Vpp. V_L and V_C are equal and opposite, so KVL still holds.

measurements.ask: Set 10 kHz and look at the phase again: how does the circuit behave?
choices: Inductive: the current lags the voltage (negative phase)
Capacitive: the current leads the voltage (positive phase)
measurements.explain: Above f0, ωL > 1/(ωC): the inductance wins and the current lags by about 78°.

hints: Series order: generator → inductor → capacitor → resistor → GND.
f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)). At f0, VR is in phase with VIN: sweep for the frequency where the phase difference crosses zero.
Below f0 the circuit is capacitive (current leads); above f0 inductive (current lags).
tests: f0: current in phase with the voltage
f0: the capacitor voltage exceeds VIN (Q > 1)

cards.title: Turn the knob, find the biggest moment
text: Three parts in one string: **inductor** (`10 mH`) **`b3`**–**`b9`**, **capacitor** (`100 nF`) **`c9`**–**`c14`**, **resistor** (`100 Ω`) **`d14`**–**`tn14`**. CH2 sits on the resistor, so it shows the current.
Generator: **sine, amplitude `1 V`**; turn the frequency slowly from **`2.5 kHz`** up to **`10 kHz`**.
CH2 grows, then shrinks. At its biggest, do the peaks of CH1 and CH2 line up?

cards.title: Two opposite "resistances" cancel
text: - The inductor's reactance $X_L = 2\pi f L$ **grows** with frequency; the capacitor's $X_C = \frac{1}{2\pi f C}$ **shrinks**.

- They pull in opposite directions: the inductor makes the current lag, the capacitor makes it lead. At the frequency where they are equal they **cancel**, and only the resistor holds the current back — the current is largest and in phase with the voltage. This is **resonance**.
![](fig:reactances)
- Setting $X_L = X_C$ gives the resonant frequency:
Work it out before you start. Below $f_0$ the capacitor wins; above $f_0$ the inductor wins.
![](fig:peak)

cards.title: Find f0, then look at the capacitor
text: - **Sweep**: find the frequency where the phase of CH2 vs CH1 crosses 0; CH2 is also largest there.
- Set **`2.5 kHz`**: read the phase of CH2 vs CH1; then set **`10 kHz`** and note the sign of the phase.

- Back at $f_0$, **clip CH2 across the capacitor**: tip into **`d9`**, ground clip into **`a14`** (the probes measure tip minus clip). Compared with CH1, is the capacitor voltage bigger or smaller than the voltage you apply?

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Series resonance**: $X_L = X_C$, the impedance is smallest (just the resistance), the current is largest and in phase with the voltage.
- Below $f_0$ the circuit is **capacitive** (current leads); above $f_0$ it is **inductive** (current lags).
- At resonance the L and C voltages are equal and opposite, and each can be several times the source voltage (Q times, the quality factor).
- Pitfall: in a high-Q series circuit the capacitor can see dozens of times the source voltage. In real circuits, check the capacitor's **voltage rating**.

tests.name: f0：电容电压比 VIN 高（Q > 1）

compare: - 当 ωL = 1/(ωC)，电抗互相抵消，|Z| 最小 = R + r，电流最大，并且电流和电压**同相**：f0 = 1/(2π√(LC)) = 1/(2π√(10 mH × 100 nF)) ≈ 5033 Hz。
- 在 f0：v_R/v_in = 100/101 ≈ 0.99，相位 ≈ 0°。电流有效值 = (1 V/√2)/(101 + 50) Ω ≈ 4.7 mA（这里要算上信号发生器的 50 Ω，因为谐振时电路的阻抗很小，50 Ω 分走了 1/3 的电压——所以 VIN 端子上只剩约 1.34 Vpp）。

- **电压放大**：谐振时 X_L = X_C = √(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω。V_C = V_L = I·316 Ω，相对端子电压 VIN 是 Q = 316/101 ≈ 3.1 倍：电容上约 4.2 Vpp，而 VIN 只有 1.34 Vpp！V̇L 和 V̇C 大小相等、方向相反，互相抵消，所以 KVL 仍然成立。（电容电压的最大值其实出现在略低于 f0 的地方，例如 4.5 kHz 时约 4.24 Vpp，但差别很小。）
- f < f0（例如 2.5 kHz）：1/(ωC) > ωL，电路呈**容性**，电流**超前**电压：v_R/v_in ≈ 0.20，相位 ≈ +78°。
- f > f0（例如 10 kHz）：ωL > 1/(ωC)，电路呈**感性**，电流**落后**电压：v_R/v_in ≈ 0.21，相位 ≈ −78°。
- 半功率点（v_R/v_in = 0.707×0.99）大约在 4.3 kHz 和 5.9 kHz，带宽 BW = (R + r)/(2πL) ≈ 1.6 kHz，f0/BW ≈ 3.1 = Q。

measurements.ask: 扫频：VR 和 VIN 同相（相位差 0°）、VR 最大的频率 f0
f = 2.5 kHz：VR（也就是电流）相对 VIN 的相位差
measurements.explain: 低于 f0 时 1/(ωC) > ωL，电路呈容性，电流超前电压，相位为正。

measurements.ask: f = 5033 Hz：CH2 夹到电容两端（针尖 d9、接地夹 a14），电容电压的 Vpp
measurements.explain: 谐振时 X_C = X_L = √(L/C) ≈ 316 Ω，电流 ≈ 4.7 mA（有效值），电容电压是 VIN 的 Q = 316/101 ≈ 3.1 倍：约 4.2 Vpp，而 VIN 只有约 1.34 Vpp。V̇L 和 V̇C 大小相等、方向相反，所以 KVL 仍然成立。

choices: 感性：电流落后电压（相位差为负）
容性：电流超前电压（相位差为正）
measurements.ask: 把频率调到 10 kHz 再看相位：电路呈什么性质？
measurements.explain: 高于 f0 时 ωL > 1/(ωC)，感抗占上风，电流落后电压约 78°。

hints: 串联顺序：信号发生器 → 电感 → 电容 → 电阻 → GND。
f0 = 1/(2π√(LC))。在 f0 处 VR 和 VIN 同相：扫频时找相位差过零的地方。
低于 f0 电路呈容性（电流超前），高于 f0 呈感性（电流落后）。
